prerequisite: Current geometry/state/motion increment must first pass integrated checks and source, clean wheel and frozen delivery. Coordinator grants the sole heavyweight-job slot before any runs.
originalContract: The original planning workload, >=2x objective, regression gates and failures remain unchanged. These controls supplement the second profile and never replace that workload.
referenceBasis: After qualification, capture the current fully verified integrated CPP source/extension/build-manifest as an immutable pre-second-pass source outside tracked dirs. Use --supplemental --baseline-source CAPTURE/src --baseline-backend cpp to compare pre-pass CPP against final CPP. Also report current reference vs current CPP separately when relevant. Exact source commit, loaded binary/build identity and fixture source hash are recorded before optimization.
workloadFreezePolicy: Literal source parameters/action sequences below are proposed from existing passing generated controls. First reference qualification must freeze result digests, available public attempt/committed-action counts and exact public traces, family inventory and any justified fixture correction before any supplementary optimization. Retain all attempted families and failure receipts. Do not tune actions, safety settings, budgets or input sizes after results for a performance claim.

measurement.primaryTiming: Whole fresh fixture/environment construction + reset + complete literal episode(s), including public action encoding/decoding where declared, rewards, observations, info, actual binding/conversion/copy costs and cleanup commands. Stop timing before comparison hashes, snapshot serialization/restore checks, output writes and attribution analysis.
measurement.separateAttribution: One separate cProfile pass per complete suite after qualification; profiler results never enter paired samples. Family-level elapsed time is diagnostic; complete-suite/episode elapsed time is authoritative.
measurement.statistics: All pairs/order, median/min/max/stdev/sample count, public attempts/episodes per second, pre-audit timed peak memory, full process-tree peak diagnostics, exact ordered requested actions/preview+step receipts/accepted history/Gym results and native backend counters. Supplement bare/Gym calls do not use TransitionMeter; do not call their requested attempt counts an actual physical microstep trace. Native substep call counts are available in separate cProfile attribution only. Original planner370-call trace remains unchanged. No p95/tail claim from five samples.
measurement.regressionLimit: Within10% of original selected workload latency and peak memory; investigate failures independently. Keep original tiny-control fixed16MiB extension-load allowance separate from input-dependent allocation.
measurement.supplementarySpeedupTarget: Report complete episode and complete simulation throughput honestly; select any additional native port only when the bounded profile shows material Python work and plausible end-to-end benefit. The existing planning2x target is unchanged.
measurement.counterSnapshot: Snapshot backend identity/counters immediately after timed work and before goal/hash/restore correctness checks, so diagnostic native-copy calls do not inflate measured workload usage.
measurement.memoryReporting: Primary supplementary memory regression compares process high-water immediately after timed work and before audit projection/restore/hash. Whole-process-tree peak including audit output allocation remains a diagnostic and must stay below the1GiB hardcap. Original planning memory rules are unchanged.

exactComparison.arrays: Preserve ndarray dtype, shape, byte order and exact C-order bytes for every returned observation/action tensor. Preserve scalar float.hex() including signed zero; JSON conversion cannot silently reduce precision.
exactComparison.simulation: Every requested action and returned complete receipt/status/reason/stateId, ordered accepted action/history chain, final full physical snapshot, source labels/affine/provenance and conservation/temperature/exposure/work ledgers. Supplementary direct/Gym episodes qualify exact available public action/receipt/history traces, not an uninstrumented claim of private physical-call accounting.
exactComparison.rl: Initial reset observation/info and seed state; every encoded action, observation, reward, reward_terms, info, termination/truncation/cleanup/budget result; final measurements, complete episode/engine snapshot and source arrays. Restore an identical saved episode after timing and compare complete restored state, observations and RNG state.
exactComparison.permittedIdentityDifferences: Only already declared backend/build identities remain outside the physical comparison; enumerate any actual process-local identity path before ports. Do not generically drop metadata/hashes.
exactComparison.workAccounting: Fixed literal public attempts including refusals and partial prefixes, separate public preview attempts, exact committed native action/history counts, and encoded Gym results. No retry-until-success, early-stop truncation or action coalescing. Do not insert timing hooks or monkeypatch production methods to infer private substeps. Existing original Generate TransitionMeter accounting remains exact and separate.
exactComparison.qualification: Generated non-patient provenance throughout. Standard safety/protected membership and unsupported continuum/vascular RL holds remain. Do not enable RL on held research physics.
exactComparison.timingSeparation: All production state/proof/semantic hashes remain endogenous and timed. Per-result typed-byte projection, equality hash, final snapshot/restore/metrics verification and report writes occur after timer and profiler stop, with auditProjectionAndRestoreSeconds and auditEqualityHashSeconds reported separately.
